MasterTemplate:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
Set-Location -LiteralPath 'F:\.codex\worktrees\ecs-relations-worker-3\SomeEngine.Next'
$source='51c8ce75949cf16d7190e14028c655f526d5697b'
$session='01a15090-f5bd-7a12-860a-e214325db5bb'
$queue='F:\SomeEngine.Next\tools\Invoke-Benchmark.ps1'
$control=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath('artifacts/relations-measurements/final-validation-r38')
$measurementRoot=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath('artifacts/ecs-relations/measurements')
$submit=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath('benchmarks/SomeEngine.ECS.Relations.Benchmarks/Submit-Measurements.ps1')
$jitReceipt='__JIT_RECEIPT__'
$readerReceipts=@('__IL_RECEIPT__','__NATIVE_RECEIPT__')
foreach($path in @($jitReceipt)+$readerReceipts){
    $gate=Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
    Write-Output ('FINAL_GATE '+$gate.Id+' '+$gate.ExitCode+' '+$gate.FinishedAtUtc)
    if($gate.ExitCode -ne 0){exit 2}
}
$packageStages=@(Get-Content -LiteralPath ("artifacts/ecs-relations/package-stages-"+$source+'.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)
if($packageStages.Count -ne 14 -or @($packageStages|Where-Object{$_.ExitCode -ne 0 -or $_.SourceCommit -ne $source}).Count -gt 0){throw 'Package stages differ.'}
git diff --exit-code $source -- '*.cs'
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit 3}
$started=[DateTime]::UtcNow
$definitions=@(
    [pscustomobject]@{Name='final-native-r38';Backend='NativeAOT';Mode='measure';ExpectedCases=108;CaseId=@();Controls=@();OnlyControls=$false},
    [pscustomobject]@{Name='final-hh-r38';Backend='NativeAOT';Mode='measure';ExpectedCases=4;CaseId=@();Controls=@('default-small-dynamic10','default-large-dynamic50','finite-small-mask1-mutual','finite-large-mask8-mutual');OnlyControls=$true},
    [pscustomobject]@{Name='final-jit-r38';Backend='JIT';Mode='measure';ExpectedCases=9;CaseId=@('finite-middle-mask4-mutual','default-middle-dynamic50','character-middle-hair16-clustered','bitmap-space-middle-uniform-mutual','character-space-middle-clustered','complete-middle-uniform','updates-middle-uniform','threads-middle-uniform-parallel','consume-middle-uniform');Controls=@();OnlyControls=$false},
    [pscustomobject]@{Name='final-phases-r38';Backend='NativeAOT';Mode='phases';ExpectedCases=9;CaseId=@('updates-small-sparse','updates-small-uniform','updates-small-dense','updates-middle-sparse','updates-middle-uniform','updates-middle-dense','updates-large-sparse','updates-large-uniform','updates-large-dense');Controls=@();OnlyControls=$false}
)
$seriesFacts=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
foreach($definition in $definitions){
    $parameters=@{Series=$definition.Name;Backend=$definition.Backend;Mode=$definition.Mode;Machine=@('Fixed');QueueScript=$queue;Session=$session;CollectReports=$true;SourceCommit=$source}
    if($definition.CaseId.Count -gt 0){$parameters.CaseId=$definition.CaseId}
    if($definition.OnlyControls){$parameters.HandwrittenControlsOnly=$true;$parameters.HandwrittenControlCaseId=$definition.Controls}
    & $submit @parameters
    $directory=Join-Path $measurementRoot $definition.Name
    $submissionPath=Join-Path $directory 'submissions.json'
    $queuePath=Join-Path $directory 'queue-submission.json'
    $submissions=@(Get-Content -LiteralPath $submissionPath -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json)
    $queueSubmission=Get-Content -LiteralPath $queuePath -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
    if($submissions.Count -ne $definition.ExpectedCases){throw "Case count differs: $($definition.Name)"}
    $seriesFacts.Add([pscustomobject]@{Series=$definition.Name;Backend=$definition.Backend;Mode=$definition.Mode;Submissions=$submissionPath;QueueSubmission=$queuePath;CaseQueueIds=@($submissions.QueueId);AnalysisQueueIds=@($queueSubmission.Reports.QueueId);SubmittedAtUtc=$queueSubmission.FinishedAtUtc})
}
$startupStarted=[DateTime]::UtcNow
$native=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath('benchmarks/SomeEngine.ECS.Relations.Benchmarks/bin/Release/net10.0/win-x64/native-publish/SomeEngine.ECS.Relations.Benchmarks.exe')
$listing=& $native --mode list --source $source
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'Native source listing failed.'}
$catalog=($listing -join [Environment]::NewLine)|ConvertFrom-Json
$startupIds=@('finite-middle-mask4-mutual','default-middle-dynamic50','character-middle-hair16-clustered','bitmap-space-middle-uniform-mutual','character-space-middle-clustered','complete-middle-uniform','updates-middle-uniform','threads-middle-uniform-parallel','consume-middle-uniform')
$startupScript=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath('benchmarks/SomeEngine.ECS.Relations.Benchmarks/Measure-Startup.ps1')
$startupSeries='final-startup-r38'
$startupRoot=Join-Path $measurementRoot $startupSeries
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $startupRoot -Force|Out-Null
$startupSubmissions=foreach($id in $startupIds){
    $case=$catalog|Where-Object Id -eq $id
    $report=Join-Path $startupRoot ($id+'.json')
    [string[]]$arguments=@('--session',$session,'pwsh','-NoProfile','-File',$startupScript,'-CaseClass',[string]$case.Class,'-Size',[string]$case.Size,'-Variant',[string]$case.Variant,'-SourceCommit',$source,'-Output',$report,'-Machine','Fixed')
    $receipt=& $queue @arguments|ConvertFrom-Json
    Write-Output ('QUEUED '+$receipt.Id+' startup '+$id)
    [pscustomobject]@{CaseId=$id;InputCaseId=$id;SourceCommit=$source;Backend='NativeAOT';Machine='Fixed';Report=$report;QueueId=$receipt.Id;QueueDirectory=$receipt.OutputDirectory}
}
$startupSubmissions|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $startupRoot 'submissions.json') -Encoding utf8
$startupAnalysis=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$encoded=[Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetBytes($startupAnalysis))
$analysis=& $queue --session $session --cpu pwsh -NoProfile -EncodedCommand $encoded|ConvertFrom-Json
$startupQueue=[pscustomobject]@{SourceCommit=$source;SubmissionCommit=(& git rev-parse HEAD).Trim();SessionId=$session;Backend='NativeAOT';Mode='startup';StartedAtUtc=$startupStarted;FinishedAtUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow;CaseCount=@($startupSubmissions).Count;Reports=@([pscustomobject]@{Script='startup-summary inline';QueueId=$analysis.Id;QueueDirectory=$analysis.OutputDirectory})}
$startupQueue|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $startupRoot 'queue-submission.json') -Encoding utf8
$seriesFacts.Add([pscustomobject]@{Series=$startupSeries;Backend='NativeAOT';Mode='startup';Submissions=(Join-Path $startupRoot 'submissions.json');QueueSubmission=(Join-Path $startupRoot 'queue-submission.json');CaseQueueIds=@($startupSubmissions.QueueId);AnalysisQueueIds=@($analysis.Id);SubmittedAtUtc=$startupQueue.FinishedAtUtc})
$manifest=[pscustomobject]@{SourceCommit=$source;SessionId=$session;Series=@($seriesFacts);CaseQueueIds=@($seriesFacts|ForEach-Object{$_.CaseQueueIds});AnalysisQueueIds=@($seriesFacts|ForEach-Object{$_.AnalysisQueueIds});SubmissionFinishedAtUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow}
$temporary=Join-Path $control 'manifest-ready.json.tmp'
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($temporary,($manifest|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8))
[IO.File]::Move($temporary,(Join-Path $control 'manifest-ready.json'),$true)
while(!(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $control 'watcher-ready.json'))){Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20}
$ready=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $control 'watcher-ready.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
$record=[pscustomobject]@{SourceCommit=$source;SessionId=$session;StartedAtUtc=$started;LastCaseSubmittedAtUtc=$manifest.SubmissionFinishedAtUtc;InitialObservationEndedAtUtc=$ready.InitialObservationEndedAtUtc;PreparationEndAtUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow;CaseCount=@($manifest.CaseQueueIds).Count;Series=@($seriesFacts);FinalQueueId=$ready.FinalQueueId}
$record|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $control 'preparation.json') -Encoding utf8
Write-Output ('PREPARATION_END '+($record|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress))
exit 0
